name: Lucky Lever
summary: A slot machine lever you pull to spin three reels into a weekend plan, printed on a ticket
about: A teal and gold slot machine for people with no Saturday plans. Pull the red-ball lever and it swings down and springs back with a wobble, the reels creep the wrong way, blur into a spin and stop one by one with a clack and a bounce on a place, an activity and a treat. A ticket prints out of the slot with the plan, and a perfect place and activity pair sets the marquee bulbs flashing and bursts out stars.
how: Press the lever (or Tab to it and press Enter), or drag the red ball down and let go.
Watch the reels stop one by one; the plan prints on the ticket below.
Press Hold under a reel to keep what it shows, then pull again to re-spin the others.
Land a perfect pair, like a sunrise hike on the Islamabad Trails, for a light show.
